title: Starting army (OOB)
intro: Place division templates on the map at game start. Exports into the same history/units/ OOB file as your templates.
emptyHint: Create one to place a division at a province.
selectHint: Select a deployment, or create one
noOwnedStates: This country owns no states yet
notInProjectStates: not in currently available project states; preserved
provincePreservedWarning: Province {province} is not in the states currently available for {tag}. Its value is preserved until you choose a replacement; this does not claim map-geometry validation.
countHint: Exports as this many divisions (names suffixed 1..N).
warnNoLocation: No location set — pick an owned province for this division.
warnUnownedProvince: Province {province} is not owned by {tag}. The division would spawn on foreign or unowned territory.
warnUnknownTag: Country tag {tag} is not one of this project's countries. Most likely the OOB file name is missing its country prefix — name it country tag + start year, e.g. ROM_1936.
warnMissingTemplate: Division template "{template}" is not defined in the Division Templates workbench. Define it there, or the OOB will fail to load.
warnNoTemplate: No division template chosen. Pick a template from the Division Templates workbench.
